chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Ch602: Li Huowang Escapes – A Fountain Pen and a Fake Doctor
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang tortures Wu Cheng for Xu Shou’s location, swaps clothes with him, and escapes from the ward by faking an emergency. But even his old doctor still thinks he’s crazy.
og_title: “I’m Not Crazy.” Li Huowang Stages a Brutal Hospital Breakout.
og_description: He shoved a pen up a man’s nose, fed him his own meds, and walked out wearing a white coat. But getting free is only half the problem.
twitter_title: Li Huowang just escaped the psych ward by turning Wu Cheng into a patient. Now he’s hunting Xu Shou.
twitter_description: Blood, pills, a swapped gown, and a doctor who still doesn’t believe him. Chapter 602 delivers the breakout.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why does Li Huowang trust Yi Donglai but not the police?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Yi Donglai is the doctor who treated him before—he represents the only institutional figure who might believe his story, whereas the police would likely write him off as a delusional patient.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why does Li Huowang block Yi Donglai after pleading for help?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Because he knows Yi will try to physically hold him inside the hospital. He only needed Yi to deliver the warning to his family; the rest of the fight he intends to handle alone.

cultural_notes_faq.q: How is this not just a generic escape scene?
cultural_notes_faq.a: The escape is psychologically specific: Li Huowang weaponizes the image of a “crazy patient” against his captor, turning the very tools of psychiatric control—a mask, a gown, antipsychotics—into instruments of reversal. It’s a commentary on whose reality gets to be believed.
